svg.title: Sudoku: from clues to a checked grid.
svg.desc: The 81-cell puzzle conditions twelve parallel code levels. Decode once, then check rows, columns, boxes and every input clue. Invalid candidates remain failures in the solve rate. Grid icons are schematic, not model predictions.

g.text: From clues to a checked grid.
One forward per level; parallel within it.
AND every input clue is preserved.
Schematic icons · no solver repair or search
